title: WILD BLUE YONDER [SINGLEPLAYER]
description: Doctor Who singleplayer modpack by Theta!
body: WILD BLUE YONDER [SINGLEPLAYER] is a modpack that includes Teab's Doctor Who mod, some quality of life mods, and biome/extra decoration block mods! It is specifically single player oriented as currently only one TARDIS can exist in a world save in Teab's mod! This may change in the future!
